description: This PHP source file interfaces with YouTrack issue tracker REST API, initializing configuration parameters, creating an issue tracker object, retrieving issue details, and making API calls related to issues and state bundles.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class managing interactions with the YouTrack REST API, including retrieving issues, statuses, and creating issues.

classes.name: APIClient
classes.description: Represents the REST API client used by tlIssueTracker to communicate with YouTrack.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: Debug utility used for printing variable contents.

methods.name: tlIssueTracker::__construct
methods.description: Constructor for tlIssueTracker, initializes connection parameters.

methods.name: tlIssueTracker::getTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available issue types from YouTrack.

methods.name: tlIssueTracker::getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific issue by ID.

methods.name: tlIssueTracker::getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Gets the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: tlIssueTracker::getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client object for further API interactions.

methods.name: APIClient::get_state_bundle
methods.description: Retrieves a bundle of states, e.g., project states.

methods.name: tlIssueTracker::addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in YouTrack.
